title: addDependencyDetails
summary: Add dependency-head tags to tokenized documents.

gpu_support.notes: `addDependencyDetails` analyzes host token strings and updates tokenizedDocument metadata; it does not use provider kernels.

description: `addDependencyDetails(documents)` adds dependency-head metadata to a RunMat `tokenizedDocument` compatibility object. Use `tokenDetails` to view the resulting `Head` and `Dependency` columns.
behaviors: RunMat ensures sentence-number details exist before computing dependencies, so `tokenDetails` returns `SentenceNumber` alongside `Head` and `Dependency`.
`Head` stores the one-based index of the syntactic head token within the same document. Root tokens use `0`.
`Dependency` stores Universal Dependencies-style labels such as `root`, `nsubj`, `obj`, `det`, `amod`, `advmod`, `case`, `obl`, `aux`, `cc`, `mark`, `punct`, `nummod`, and `dep`.

RunMat uses deterministic English and German compatibility rules over the shared part-of-speech classifier. Existing Japanese or Korean language metadata is accepted with conservative token-class-aware fallback dependencies.
Exact MathWorks statistical dependency-parser parity, MeCab-backed Japanese/Korean tokenization, and broader language-detail model parity remain tracked as Text Analytics work.

faqs.question: Does `addDependencyDetails` use a full parser model?
faqs.answer: No. This compatibility slice uses deterministic dependency rules and records exact MathWorks parser parity as remaining Text Analytics work.

faqs.question: Does `addDependencyDetails` execute on the GPU?
faqs.answer: No. It updates host tokenizedDocument metadata.

points: No name-value options are supported for this MATLAB-compatible form.
Use `tokenDetails(updatedDocuments)` to view the resulting `Head` and `Dependency` table columns.

gpu_residency: `addDependencyDetails` updates host tokenizedDocument metadata and has no provider kernel.
